note: Who else has checked Tamil Nadu's industrial-policy performance, and what question each source answers. Compiled 2026-07-11. Every entry was retrieved and read except where marked; scanned-only documents are listed with their existence verified but content not machine-checked.

entries.title: Audit Report (Public Sector Undertakings), Government of Tamil Nadu, year ended 31 March 2018 — Report No. 2 of 2020
entries.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
entries.quantifies: Performance audits of SIPCOT (892.74 acres of allotted land unused and not repossessed; Rs 249.94 crore foregone; 39.5% of allottable SEZ land vacant) and of TANGEDCO power purchase (Rs 605.48 crore excess expenditure from an extended solar tariff window).
entries.question_answered: Did the implementing machinery run properly? Not whether policy outcome targets were met.

entries.title: Audit Report (Public Sector Undertakings), Government of Tamil Nadu, year ended March 2016 — Report No. 7 of 2016
entries.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
entries.quantifies: Performance audit of TIIC lending to MSMEs 2011-16 (rising NPAs, Rs 139 crore of overdues traced to sanction and monitoring deficiencies) and TIDCO's uncollected Rs 46.65 crore joint-venture service charge.
entries.question_answered: Financial propriety of the state's industrial-finance institutions.

entries.title: Audit Report (Revenue Sector), Government of Tamil Nadu, year ended 31 March 2016 — Report No. 2 of 2017, section 2.5, Audit of Tax Exemption to Industries
entries.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
entries.quantifies: Rs 170.93 crore of excess VAT refunds to six companies under the structured packages of assistance administered through SIPCOT.
entries.question_answered: Whether incentive disbursement followed its own rules.

entries.title: Public Accounts Committee reports on the Industries and MSME departments (67th, 73rd, 76th and 96th reports, XV Assembly)
entries.quantifies: Committee follow-up on CAG audit paragraphs concerning the Industries and MSME departments. The reports are scanned documents, largely in Tamil; their existence is verified but their content has not been machine-checked for this register.

entries.title: Tamil Nadu Industrial Policy 2021, section 2.3 'Progress and New Goals' (G.O. Ms. No. 74)
entries.publisher: Government of Tamil Nadu, Industries Department
entries.quantifies: The only government self-score of a Tamil Nadu industrial policy: a one-time retrospective on the 2014 policy inside the 2021 policy document. It scores the 2014 job-creation goal against total registered-factory employment (a stock, not the promised flow of new jobs).
entries.question_answered: The state's own one-off account of the 2014 policy at handover. Annual Policy Notes and the Economic Survey report trends but never score the policies' targets.

entries.title: Location-Based Tax Incentives: Evidence from India
entries.quantifies: Difference-in-differences estimates of the 2003 Uttarakhand/Himachal tax exemptions: large gains in firm counts, employment and output in treated states.
entries.question_answered: Causal effects of a central place-based incentive — methodological precedent, not Tamil Nadu.

entries.title: Do special economic zones induce developmental spillovers? Evidence from India's states
entries.quantifies: Census-based analysis across the major SEZ states including Tamil Nadu: no local socioeconomic spillovers from SEZs.
entries.question_answered: One of the few causal papers whose sample explicitly includes Tamil Nadu; the state is never the isolated unit of analysis.

entries.title: Place-based policies and firm performance: Evidence from Special Economic Zones in India
entries.quantifies: Firm-panel estimates: negative average productivity effects inside Indian SEZs, no spillovers.
entries.question_answered: National SEZ instrument evaluation; no state-specific target assessment.

entries.title: Place-based policies, structural change and female labor: Evidence from India's Special Economic Zones
entries.publisher: Journal of Public Economics 240 (Gallé, Overbeck, Riedel, Seidel)
entries.quantifies: Employment gains within 10 km of SEZs established 2005-13, with agricultural (especially female) employment declining — structural-change effects.
entries.question_answered: National SEZ evaluation; Tamil Nadu not isolated.

entries.title: Tamil Nadu's Electronics Industry: Lessons for 'Make in India'
entries.quantifies: Survey-based account of why Tamil Nadu electronics stagnated pre-2015: weak backward linkages and an import-intensive production model.
entries.question_answered: Descriptive sector diagnosis for Tamil Nadu; not a target evaluation.

entries.title: State Finances: A Study of Budgets
entries.quantifies: State-wise subsidy expenditure trends; press coverage of the 2024-25 edition reports a steep rise in Tamil Nadu's total subsidy bill. Total subsidies span power, transport and transfers — not industrial incentives specifically.
entries.question_answered: Fiscal sustainability of state spending, not industrial-policy outcomes.

entries.title: Business Reforms Action Plan (BRAP) state assessments
entries.publisher: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
entries.quantifies: Cross-state ease-of-doing-business assessment; Tamil Nadu placed in the Top Achiever category in the 2020 round.
entries.question_answered: Regulatory-process quality relative to other states, not outcomes against Tamil Nadu's own targets.
